prompt: Who was the last Miss World America to place in the Top 11 at Miss World? Hint: She has pursued a modeling career.
answer: The last Miss World America to place in the **Top 11 at Miss World** was **Audra Mari**, Miss World America 2016. She achieved the placement at **Miss World 2016** and later pursued a modeling and television-hosting career.
